faq.a: Both process background jobs. Sidekiq requires Ruby and Redis. Drover is a single Go binary with HTTP API, usable from any language.

faq.q: Is Drover as fast as Sidekiq?
faq.a: No. Sidekiq with Redis handles millions of jobs/sec. Drover with SQLite handles thousands/sec. For most applications, thousands/sec is sufficient.

seo_title: Cutoff vs Kong — Self-hosted rate limiting at $0.99/mo
seo_description: Kong Plus is $250/mo for advanced rate limiting. Cutoff is a standalone rate limiter — single binary, $0.99/mo. Sliding window, IP/key limiting.

Cutoff is a standalone rate limiter, not a Kong plugin. Use Cutoff as a sidecar or reverse proxy in front of your API.

seo_title: Exchequer vs Stripe Billing — Self-hosted subscription management
seo_description: Stripe Billing charges 0.5% of revenue. Exchequer is self-hosted subscription management — $2.99/mo flat. Manage plans and usage on your server.

faq.a: No. Exchequer manages subscription logic and usage metering. You still need Stripe or another payment processor for actual charges.

faq.q: Why use Exchequer if I need Stripe anyway?
faq.a: Exchequer keeps your billing logic and customer data on your server. Stripe handles payments. The 0.5% Billing fee is on top of processing fees — Exchequer removes that layer.
